name: Kit · Logo in dark luxe
description: Studio kit starter: your SVG logo extruded in chrome / gold / black gloss / brand lacquer, floating above a dark seamless set with a soft blurred floor reflection (S.studio dark_luxe): strip rim lights trace the edges, a halo glows on the wall, the logo turns from 3/4 to front while the camera dollies in, a light bar sweeps across at the end. Premium brand idents and end cards; 16:9 and 9:16.
